scientific_defect: The first software addendum placed exact delivery month set inside the local cell identity. That would prevent M1 from accumulating across phases and make the M2 phase residual structurally redundant.
phase_role: Exact delivery calendar month set is stored as a separate covariate. M1 accumulates the base cell across phases; M2 uses only prior prequential M1 innovations from the same exact phase.

first_event_repair.only_change: deterministic posterior cell reindexing with phase retained in the observation state
